ZAP baseline TASK-016 (first baseline): Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens on the local-mode sign-in form (AUTH_MODE=local, refused in staging and production). The hosted sign-in is the identity provider's component, not this form; the api authenticates with a bearer token, never a cookie, so there is no ambient credential to forge. Product defect filed for the Frontend Engineer to confirm and close.

ZAP baseline TASK-016 (first baseline): CSP style-src 'unsafe-inline' on every web page. The framework and component styles are inline today; script-src is nonce-based with no unsafe-inline. Product defect filed for the Frontend Engineer and Security Reviewer to remove inline styles or move to style nonces.

ZAP baseline TASK-016 (first baseline): the web page loads the identity provider's browser scripts from a CDN without an integrity attribute (the file is versioned by the provider and changes without notice, so a fixed hash would break sign-in); in local mode the script host is also empty (https:///npm/...). Product defect filed for the Frontend Engineer: serve the provider script from the provider's frontend host with a pinned version, and do not render it in local mode.

picomatch 4.0.7 (GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf, regex DoS via single-branch repeated extglob such as +(*)); no patched version exists (latest published is 4.0.7), so no upgrade or override is possible. Reached only through build and test tooling: dependency-cruiser, typescript-eslint, vite/vitest (dev), and @sentry/nextjs -> @rollup/plugin-commonjs and vite via tinyglobby (build-time bundler plugins). Every glob given to it is a literal from this repository's own config or from the build; no request-handling or user-supplied glob reaches it, and the API runtime image does not use it (pnpm why --prod shows it only under @shroomap/web build dependencies). Re-check for a patched release at expiry. Needs Security Reviewer review.
